Atta Boy! I have been tagged for second time in my sacredly puny life! :D and this time it’s IRIS who has done the honour for me!!

Here we go…

I am thinking about…

  3. DP (friend from past…don’t know if I like her or not)
    And
  4. About what do I really want to do in life.
    (for 2:31 am in night… not much..eh?)

I said…

  1. Fuck you bitch
    (to one of my closest friends, when she called up 2 hours back and was sarcastic about me mean)

I want to…

  1. Do something revolutionary
    And
  2. “Not” give a fuck about anyone else.

I wish…

  1. Kids won’t have anything to cry about until they are 20 yrs. old.
  2. Women are more liberalized in true sense
    and
  3. That I am true to myself and others.

I hear…
Nothing…

I wonder…
If there is really a god? And If he as scared of my “will” as I am of “his”.

I regret…
nothing as yet!

I am…
Hypocrite

I dance…
when I am alone.

I sing…
Oasis - Wonderwall while riding bike. (because I know that song well, and it does not have any high notes)

I cry…
In pillow to sleep, sometimes.

I am not always…
Truthful.

I make with my hands…
Code?

I write…
Crap!

I confuse…
excuse and reason to myself, for not doing something.

I need…
Love and acceptance of my flaws.

I tag…
